research_notes: Follow up hospitality employers/hours/intervals, military full-time service and injury/leave boundaries, and dates for Nicklin, D'Ath and Chisholm offices. Resolve whether environmental-management experience includes any paid employment beyond study/governance/political work.

Initial pass 2026-09-29 reviewed parliamentary biography, first speech, member/party profiles, local direct-interview reporting, UniSC event biography, indexed 2021/2023 university reports, 2023 Student Senate report, and later first-person parliamentary accounts. Searches for hospitality employer and military hours found no adequate person-specific evidence.

Public professional-profile searches returned US social-work/pharmacy/student profiles, UK governance/childcare profiles and an artist. Identity matches were not established; no such careers imported. Current advertisements for staff in Comer's office are jobs she offers, not evidence of her own prior full-time status.

University reports distinguish elected students from academic/general staff. Council and Student Senate service overlap studies and later political staffing, but neither creates public-service employment years under the governance exclusion.

January 2013 to January 2014 is not converted into an exact one-year qualifying total without verified service status, endpoints and leave treatment. Hospitality 2016 observation is retained in notes rather than used as a fabricated full-year spell. Both totals unknown; blocked record remains unresolved.

2026-10-02 follow-up: primary indexed Gorman interview identifies paid fish-and-chip-shop first job, expanding earlier unspecified hospitality record. Direct Facebook retrieval returned Online fetch throttled; targeted index searches recovered only opening answer. No age/date, employer name or later answers inferred. Searches on hospitality employers, sea rescue, Duntroon and study did not resolve earlier gaps. UK/US job and university namesakes and vacancies offered by Comers current office excluded. Next: accessible full first-job interview or self-published CV, employer/venue confirmation, and individual military service/leave evidence. No full-time total calculable.

2026-10-03 follow-up: official ADF Careers material identifies the Royal Military College officer-entry course as 18 months of full-time paid training. In combination with the APH person-specific Staff Cadet interval, Comer's Army spell is now coded full-time. The source does not resolve individual injury absence or exact cessation, and no month-boundary duration is calculated without a common published convention. Searches for named hospitality employers and dated political-office transitions did not yield additional person-specific evidence. Next: individual service/medical-discharge or leave evidence, accessible full first-job interview, employer/venue confirmation, and dated office records.

2026-10-04 follow-up (second nationwide pass): exact office-by-office searches found a 2025 first-person interview in which Anthony Chisholm calls Comer his former staffer, corroborating the final named office, and Skelton's existing post-election acknowledgement of her Nicklin-office service. Neither supplies appointment/cessation dates, title, hours or allocation within APH's April 2023–April 2025 umbrella. No reliable Yvette D'Ath personnel record or named hospitality/sea-rescue employer surfaced. Revisit only with parliamentary staffing, ministerial diary, payroll or accessible full-interview evidence.

Targeted follow-up2026-10-05: Fully inspected primary2022UniSCorganising-committee biographies, refining generic environmental/governance experience with identified StudentsasPartners team and Roundtable organising activity. University specifically labels Comer a student; pay, hours and appointment boundaries remain unstated. Adjacent profile foundations-teaching/AFHEA qualification belongs to KristieJones, SenateAdminAssistant job to JordanPertile, and StudentPartnershipsAssistant to AnastasiiaKuleshova; none assigned to Comer.2025universityprofessionalpost reiterates studentCouncil/Senate service only. Hospitality/sea-rescue and fish-shop searches yielded no attributable venue or individual leave/discharge document. UnitedStatespharmacy/chemistry and Virginia university profiles are namesakes. Preserve paidArmyfull-time evidence but unresolved injury/absence and month-only boundary calculation.
